department: Faculty of Engineering — Department of Computer Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Main Round and HKPFS application deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (Clearing Round: March 31, 2027, subject to availability).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in this field).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Department MPhil-PhD admission page does not state a pre-application supervisor contact requirement.

funding.value: All full-time research students receive Postgraduate Studentships (HK$229,200/yr in 2026-27, approx. HK$19,100/mo) during their normative study period.
funding.quote: All full-time research students will receive Studentships during their normative study period.

also.quote: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400). Payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits both bachelor's holders (direct to pre-candidacy PhD or MPhil stream) and master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Articulated MPhil-PhD programmes provide a pathway for students with a Bachelor's degree to pursue a PhD. Initially, students are admitted as either MPhil students or pre-candidacy PhD students.

notes: CSE also runs an online pre-application review portal (dept-eappsrv.cse.cuhk.edu.hk/pgas2027/). Companion Department of Information Engineering (ie.cuhk.edu.hk) also supervises PhD research in networking, communications, cybersecurity, information theory, and AI.
